info.name: Kongamano API
info.description:
Kongamano REST API (CodeIgniter 4).

1. Set `baseUrl` (default: http://localhost/kongamano).
2. Run **Login** — the token is saved automatically.
3. All other requests use Bearer auth via collection variable `token`.

Default dev credentials: admin / 1234

exec: console.log("Token saved to collection variable: token");
